taxonomy.note: Kew/POWO accepted name used canonically. Some regional sources show an expanded author citation; the taxon concept is the same.

evidence: Hays — Beautiful Hays County documents volunteer Bouteloua gracilis thriving on an unmanaged dry slope and treats it within the local native-grass context; BONAP is retained as the primary native-range authority.
Uvalde — Texas A&M/OakTrust Uvalde vascular-plant survey records Bouteloua gracilis collected in Uvalde (collection 824, 25 Oct 2002).
Crockett — USDA-NRCS Plant Materials Center blue grama evaluation lists accession 9093104 with origin Crockett County, Texas.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Blue grama is less strongly represented in the local source pool than the other B002 species. The Hays record is local field evidence rather than a herbarium voucher, so that evidence strength is preserved explicitly; BONAP county mapping is the primary distribution authority and no county is inferred from ecoregion mapping.

morphology.look_here_first: Look at the number and shape of the flowering branches: blue grama usually has 1–3 conspicuous unilateral racemes shaped like curved eyebrows or rooster combs, with spikelets packed all the way to the branch tip.
diagnostic_traits: perennial tufted/caespitose warm-season grass with short stout rhizomes
leaves concentrated mainly near the base
usually 1–3 conspicuous curved unilateral pectinate racemes
racemes about 1.5–5 cm long and spreading to arcuate
many crowded spikelets continue to the end of the raceme
no long naked rachis tip or 'stinger' beyond the spikelets

confusers.separator: Blue grama usually presents 1–3 longer curved comb-like racemes; Texas grama has roughly 5–9 much shorter fuzzy/awned branches.
Blue grama's spikelets run to the branch tip; hairy/tall grama relatives can leave the rachis projecting beyond the spikelets as a distinct 'stinger'.
Sideoats grama has numerous short racemes spaced along a long central axis; blue grama has only a few longer curved combs near the top.

diagnostic_roles: branch tip showing no projecting stinger

installation_guardrail: Do not install until Calvin explicitly approves B002.
